specs.Recommended Uses For Product: Charging, Data Transfer, Mobile Device Connectivity

features: 60W PD Fast Charging: Portronics Konnect X, a Type C to Type C PD cable, provides fast charging with a max output of 60W to charge all your Type C devices faster than ever with compatible USB-C adapters.
Type-C for Various Power Levels: The 60W USB-C cable is backward compatible with lower power 45W 30W 18W 15W and below USB-C power adapters.
Nylon Braided Cable: This cable has nylon jacket braiding and aluminum alloy shells which makes it stronger, unbreakable, and tangle-free. Experience durability with fast charging capabilities.
1 Cable for all Type C Devices: It is compatible with laptops, tablets, Type-C smartphones, earbuds, etc., that have Type C ports, such as the iPhone 15 series, MacBook, iPad, Samsung Galaxy.
Data Transfer: Konnect X Type C cable supports data transfer, which means you can transfer data like videos, photos, files, etc. from one USB C device to another at a speed of 480 Mbps.
2m Portable Cable: With a convenient 2-meter length, this Type C cable is perfect for use at home, in the office, in the car, during travel, and anywhere else you need it.
Warranty: The Konnect X Type C to Type C cable comes with a warranty of 6 months against manufacturing defects.
description: Tired of waiting for your gadgets to charge? Enter Portronics Konnect X, the speedster of USB-C cables. This 60W PD Fast Charging marvel ensures your Type C devices hit peak power in no time. Its versatile compatibility spans laptops, tablets, smartphones, and more. Reinforced with a nylon braided jacket and aluminum alloy shells, this cable is unbreakable and tangle-free. it's your reliable companion everywhere. Plus, enjoy data transfer at 480 Mbps. Don't settle for slow – Konnect X is your ticket to swift charging and seamless connectivity, backed by a 6-month warranty.
